Food Science in Cambodia

Kosal Nith
Micro-Policy Intervention: Contemporary Policy Discussion in Cambodia · Future Forum · 2021

Abstract

This paper examines how the development of food science, the role of R&D in the promotion, and the development of the food industry could positively impact the agricultural sector in Cambodia.

Keywords: Food Science; R&D; Agriculture; Policy; Cambodia
